newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-NILIS OUT FOR WALES MATCH, ALBERT DOUBTFUL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NILIS OUT FOR WALES MATCH, ALBERT DOUBTFUL.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven striker Luc Nilis has pulled out of Belgium's squad for Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Wales in Cardiff, coach Georges Leekens said on Monday.
"I don't think he'll be able to play in the next few weeks...it's serious, his ankle," Leekens told VTM television.
Newcastle defender Philippe Albert is doubtful with a knee injury and Belgium's 1996 player of the year Franky Van der Elst has a groin problem.
Nilis, last season's leading striker in the Dutch first division and named Netherlands Player of the Year, sustained an ankle injury late last month.
"Perhaps he started again too early and forced his ankle," Leekens said.
Belgium must avoid defeat to stay in the running for second place in European qualifying group seven. They are currently third, behind the Netherlands and Wales.
